newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seizes Arabic weekly newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seizes Arabic weekly newspaper.

text.p: Morocco seized the latest issue of the Arabic weekly newspaper al-Moustakillah, apparently because of a report on Moslem fundamentalists in the kingdom, the newspaper said on Friday.
"Moroccan authorities seized the copy of January 25 and banned it from distribution in the kingdom," al-Mustakillah said. The newspaper said no reason was given.
But Fathi Belhaj, the newspaper's correspondent in Rabat, said: "We believe a six-page report on Moslem fundamentalists activity in Morocco contained in the issue was the target of the seizure."
Officials were not immediately available for comment.
Al-Mustakillah, which is printed in London, distributes several hundred copies in the North African country.
